figures.title: Share of the U.S. labor force, by generation

chart.heading: Share of the U.S. labor force, by generation

figures.description: As of 2024, Gen Z workers outnumber baby boomers, with millennials representing the largest generational cohort in the workforce. By 2030, Gen Z workers will account for more than 30% of the workforce, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.
notes: Source: “Changes in the U.S. Labor Supply,” Trendlines, U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, August 2024.
